desc:
⚔️ MAKE THE STRONGEST ANIME TEAM
Sit at a table, face another player in a 1v1 AUCTION and bid on legendary anime fighters. Build the strongest team of 5, then watch them fight!

🔥 More than 15 ANIME UNIVERSES to play, and a MULTIVERSE mode where they all collide!

🎲 Every match gives you LUCKY BLOCKS with PETS that earn cash while you play.
✨ Collect all 150 pets, hunt the SHINY ones, roll TRAITS and unlock TITLES.
🏆 Buy chairs, spin the wheel, climb the leaderboards and become the king of the server!

👥 +10% cash for every friend playing with you!
🔄 Rebirth to earn more, forever.

🎁 CODES: RELEASE | SHINY | STRONGEST | 8DXTCP
Redeem them with the ticket button at the top of your screen!
👍Next code at 1,000 likes!

❤️ Like and ⭐ Favorite to get more codes!
📱 Playable on PC, mobile and console.
